THE EVIDENCE

Which approach earns its place?

Lower Brier score means better number inclusion probabilities. Match counts measure the selected seven-number line. Positive improvement beats uniform probabilities.

ModelBrier ↓Avg matches ↑3+ matchesBrier improvement ± 3 SE

Intervals are exploratory paired estimates, not proof of an edge. Promotion requires at least 100 current-era test draws and an improvement interval above zero. Live results are tracked separately.

EXPERIMENT DESIGN

Change the hypothesis. Keep the evidence.

01 / Separate the eras

7/49 at launch. 7/50 from May 14, 2019, alongside Tuesday draws and the RNG transition. 7/52 from April 14, 2026. Each number-pool change resets model training.

02 / Make an honest comparison

Start each era with 30 training draws, forecast the next, score it, then expand training by one draw. Frequency, 30/100 draw windows, gaps and transitions feed an adaptive ensemble.

03 / Adapt after scoring

The ensemble updates weights using earlier Brier losses. After a miss, inspect the probabilities assigned to the actual numbers. A proposed change gets a new version and needs future validation.

Rule changes, data provenance and limitations

2015: jackpot cap increased to $60M. May 2019: pool, schedule, draw mechanism and prize changes; cap $70M. September 10, 2024: cap $80M, same number pool. April 14, 2026: $6 for four lines, pool 52, cap $90M and MAXPLUS. Jackpot changes are documented but are not input signals for this main-number experiment.

Data validation checks complete scheduled draw coverage, unique dates, seven distinct main numbers, a separate bonus, and era-specific ranges. Corrections to errors found in the archive are explicitly documented in history.json and the README. Structural validation does not independently verify every historical number.
